title: Dream-COP: Guiding Algorithm Discovery for Combinatorial Optimization Problems in an Experience World
abstract: arXiv:2610.36618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) through iterative program generation and evaluation. A central challenge is how to organize search to discover better algorithms within a limited budget. Our key insight is that past search trajectories and their recorded outcomes form an experience world, which can be used to facilitate the COP solving through replay. We introduce Dream-COP, in which a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs. Specifically, policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively. translated_title: Dream-COP：在经验世界中引导组合优化问题的算法发现
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过迭代的程序生成与评估，能够为组合优化问题（COP）进行算法发现。其核心挑战在于如何组织搜索，以便在有限预算内发现更好的算法。我们的关键洞察是：过去的搜索轨迹及其记录的结果构成了一个“经验世界”，可以通过回放来辅助求解组合优化问题。我们提出了 Dream-COP，其中“策略智能体”通过在这个经验世界中“做梦”来学习可执行的策略，以引导“发现智能体”生成并改进组合优化问题的程序。具体而言，策略回放能够对所发现程序的质量以及所使用的搜索步骤提供反馈，从而更有效地指导策略选择。在五个组合优化问题上，Dream 在启发式组件设计和完整求解器生成两个方面都发现了优于固定探索的更好算法。
tldr: Dream-COP 通过让策略智能体在由历史搜索轨迹构成的经验世界中“做梦回放”来学习可执行策略，从而在有限搜索预算下引导 LLM 为组合优化问题发现更好的算法。
en_tdlr: Dream-COP enables LLM-based algorithm discovery for combinatorial optimization problems by having a policy agent "dream" in an experience world of past search trajectories, guiding the discovery agent to find better algorithms within a limited search budget.
